title: Quantum magic state cleanup cuts errors 40-fold in first successful hardware test
title_zh: 量子魔态清理在首次成功的硬件测试中将错误减少了 40 倍
summary: 量子比特是数字比特的量子等价物，它很脆弱并且容易出错。这使得构建可靠的量子计算机变得极其困难。一种解决方法是使用传统的魔法状态蒸馏，它可以过滤掉缺陷，但它非常消耗资源。
abstract: Qubits, the quantum equivalent of digital bits, are fragile and prone to errors. That makes building reliable quantum computers extremely difficult. One fix has been to use traditional magic state distillation, which filters out flaws, but it is extremely resource-intensive.

title: Hybrid diamond chip strengthens interactions between light and quantum bits
title_zh: 混合金刚石芯片增强了光和量子比特之间的相互作用
summary: 研究人员开发并演示了一种新型混合光子平台，该平台将量子发射器与光子器件集成在一起，提供了一种可靠控制光子与量子信息载体之间相互作用的方法。该基于芯片的平台将磷化镓（GaP）与金刚石基板相结合，通过提供一种长距离连接量子设备的方法，可以帮助使量子网络更加实用。
abstract: Researchers have developed and demonstrated a new hybrid photonic platform that integrates quantum emitters with photonic devices, providing a way to reliably control the interaction between photons and quantum information carriers. The chip-based platform, which combines gallium phosphide (GaP) with a diamond substrate, could help make quantum networks more practical by providing a way to connect quantum devices over long distances.
